name: @pipeworx/mcp-big-mac-index

tools.name: big_mac_index
tools.description: The Economist Big Mac index for a country: the local Big Mac price, the dollar exchange rate, the dollar price, and the raw and GDP-adjusted over/under-valuation of the currency against USD, EUR, GBP, JPY and CNY, for one index release (default the latest) or the full history since 2000. Omit country to list every country in one release. Source: The Economist big-mac-data (MIT).

country.description: Country name as The Economist spells it ("Switzerland", "Britain", "Euro area"), ISO3 code ("CHE") or currency code ("CHF"). Omit for all countries.

date.description: Index release: YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD or "latest" (default). Resolves to the latest release on or before it.

history.description: With a country: return every release since 2000 instead of one (oldest first). Ignores date.

tools.name: big_mac_valuation
tools.description: Rank every currency in a Big Mac index release by how over- or under-valued it is against a base currency (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY or CNY), raw or GDP-adjusted, most overvalued first. Use for "which currencies are cheapest/most expensive by the Big Mac index". Source: The Economist big-mac-data (MIT).

date.description: Index release: YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD or "latest" (default).

adjusted.description: Rank by the GDP-adjusted valuation instead of raw (default false).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-big-mac-index forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the big-mac-index pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
